name: record_take_outcome
description: After rebuilding a take retrieved with get_take, record the real result: landed (built and kept close to the draft), adapted (kept parts), or abandoned (not used; give a reason). reportedBy is agent for your own result, user only when explicitly told by the user. Report typecheck/build from real runs. Never send code, paths, prompts or project details. Free, owner-only, for a take retrieved in the last 14 days.
